> Please verify that for Crypto the new `Decomposer` is used instead of the `Forex.DecomposeCurrencyPair`/or the old way, example https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Brokerages/Oanda/OandaBrokerage.cs#L155 should be replaced too, else will cause runtime errors

I've checked all `Forex.DecomposeCurrencyPair` references and can't see where I need to replace it including what you mentioned. Firstly, the line you highlighted under `SecurityType.Forex` condition so `Forex.DecomposeCurrencyPair` can be applied successfully here, isn't it?
Secondly, `Crypto.DecomposeCurrencyPair` will depend on SecurityProperties to get quoteCurrency properly, that's why it's difficult to use it everywhere.

> I've checked all Forex.DecomposeCurrencyPair references and can't see where I need to replace it including what you mentioned. Firstly, the line you highlighted under SecurityType.Forex condition so Forex.DecomposeCurrencyPair can be applied successfully here, isn't it?
Secondly, Crypto.DecomposeCurrencyPair will depend on SecurityProperties to get quoteCurrency properly, that's why it's difficult to use it everywhere.

Firstly -> Your right! sorry about that.
Secondly -> Agree, that's why I was mentioning its important to verify/detect specifically where _everywhere_ is (_if any case_), so we can find a way around it, maybe even finding another source of the quote/base currency -> for example the `Crypto/Forex` `Security` have the data (see `IBaseCurrencySymbol`).

Merging but suggest we think about rejigging this implementation from IF branches to layered attempts:

1) Use the separator character in ticker string if the user provides one.
2) Use Symbol DB if we find it in the DB.
3) Fall back on using the current 6 character split if 1,2 fail to provide viable options.

issue_context.title: Custom Account Currenty has a limitation on its length
issue_context.body:
<!--- This template provides sections for bugs and features. Please delete any irrelevant sections before submitting -->

#### Expected Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the behavior you expect to see for your case. -->
Custom Account currency should accept any custom currency with different length. For example, Binance uses USDT (pegged currency) as account curreny.

#### Actual Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the actual behavior for your case. -->
I setup an Account curreny using
`SetAccountCurrency("USDT");`
And get an ArgumentException "Cash symbols must be exactly 3 characters."

#### Reproducing the Problem
<!--- Required for Bugs. Describe how to reproduce the problem. This can be via a failing unit test or a simplified algorithm that reliably demonstrates this issue.  -->
Use any Binance account to replicate the problem.
